_comment: Geometry for the 3D line view (/dashboard/line). Entirely optional: a line with no entry here is laid out from its routing order, evenly spaced, with each machine's silhouette inferred from its name. This file is where you correct that — give a station an explicit `kind` when the guess is wrong, or explicit `x`/`z`/`rot` (metres, degrees) when the line is not a straight run.
_kinds: depalletiser | denester | washer | inspector | filler | palletiser | mixer | packer | generic
_why_not_the_tag_map: The tag map is the wiring diagram between MES equipment and OPC objects. Where a machine physically stands is a different question, edited by different people at different times, so it lives in a different file.

SIMLINE._comment: The KepSim returnable-bottle line: trays of empties in at LD01, filled bottles palletised at PAL01.

LINE1._comment: The seeded cola line. Two machines, so it renders short — the same scene, honestly reflecting a smaller plant.
